title: Taxing Capital to Protect It
abstract: arXiv:2609.19764v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper studies the composition of taxation when the government cannot fully commit to respecting private returns after investment. A fiscal authority must finance a given expenditure from labor and capital income. Ordinary tax receipts are protected, but an opportunistic executive can seize part of the remaining capital payment. We show that a revenue-neutral increase in the capital tax raises the probability of compliance whenever the labor tax is below its local, fixed-wage revenue peak, provided the equilibrium remains on a regular mixing branch. This result does not depend on the elasticity of substitution between capital and labor. The same reform can raise investment: the gain in expected retention must outweigh the decline in the opportunist's continuation gain as compliance becomes less informative. translated_abstract: 本文研究了当政府无法完全承诺尊重投资后的私人回报时，税收的构成问题。财政当局必须从劳动收入和资本收入中筹集既定的支出。普通税收收入是受到保护的，但机会主义的行政者可以扣押剩余资本支付中的一部分。我们证明，只要劳动税率低于其在固定工资下的局部收入峰值，且均衡保持在常规混合分支上，税收中性的资本税提高就会提高合规的概率。这一结果不依赖于资本与劳动之间的替代弹性。同样的改革还可以提高投资：预期的资本保留收益的增益必须超过随着合规的信息含量下降而引起的机会主义者延续收益的减少。我们还刻画了完全合规条件下的拉姆齐配置。有限承诺随之对可持续……施加了一个上限（原文此处截断）。
tldr: 在政府无法完全承诺保护资本回报的框架下，税收中性的资本税提高反而能提升合规概率，并有可能同时促进投资。
